include { FCS_FCSADAPTOR  } from 'nf-core/fcs/fcsadaptor'
include { FCSGX_RUNGX     } from 'nf-core/fcsgx/rungx'

workflow FASTA_CLEAN_FCS {

    take:
    ch_fasta     // channel: [ val(meta), [ fasta ] ]
    database     // channel: [ db ]
    ramdisk_path // value: the path to the ramdisk

    main:

    ch_fasta.map{
        meta, _fasta -> [ meta.taxid ?: error("taxid is mandatory in the meta map") ]
    }

    FCS_FCSADAPTOR ( ch_fasta )

    ch_cleaned_assembly = ch_fasta
        .join(FCS_FCSADAPTOR.out.cleaned_assembly, by:0, remainder: true )
        .map { meta, input, cleaned ->
            [ meta, meta.taxid, cleaned ?: input ]
        }

    FCSGX_RUNGX ( ch_cleaned_assembly, database, ramdisk_path)

    emit:
    fcsadaptor_cleaned_assembly = ch_cleaned_assembly                       // channel: [ val(meta), [ cleaned_assembly ] ]
    fcsadaptor_report           = FCS_FCSADAPTOR.out.adaptor_report         // channel: [ val(meta), [ adaptor_report ] ]
    fcsadaptor_log              = FCS_FCSADAPTOR.out.log                    // channel: [ val(meta), [ log ] ]
    fcsadaptor_pipeline_args    = FCS_FCSADAPTOR.out.pipeline_args          // channel: [ val(meta), [ pipeline_args ] ]
    fcsadaptor_skipped_trims    = FCS_FCSADAPTOR.out.skipped_trims          // channel: [ val(meta), [ skipped_trims ] ]
    fcsgx_report                = FCSGX_RUNGX.out.fcsgx_report              // channel: [ val(meta), [ fcs_gx_report ] ]
    fcsgx_taxonomy_report       = FCSGX_RUNGX.out.taxonomy_report           // channel: [ val(meta), [ taxonomy_report ] ]
    fcsgx_log                   = FCSGX_RUNGX.out.log                       // channel: [ val(meta), [ log ] ]
    fcsgx_hits                  = FCSGX_RUNGX.out.hits                      // channel: [ val(meta), [ hits ] ]
}

---
name: "nf-core/fasta_clean_fcs"
description: "Foreign Contamination Screen (FCS) is a tool suite for identifying and\
  \ removing contaminant sequences in genome assemblies"
keywords:
- "contamination screening"
- "cleaning"
- "assemblies"
- "fasta"
components:
- "fcs/fcsadaptor"
- "fcsgx/rungx"
input:
- ch_fasta:
    type: "file"
    description: "Channel containing the assembly to screen. The meta map must carry\
      \ the\ntaxonomy ID of the expected organism, e.g. [ id:'test', taxid:'id' ].\n\
      \nStructure: [ val(meta), path(fasta) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{fasta,fa}"
- database:
    type: "directory"
    description: "Directory containing the FCS-GX database.\n\nStructure: [ path(database)\
      \ ]\n"
- ramdisk_path:
    type: "string"
    description: "Path to RAM disk for improved performance (optional)"
output:
- fcsadaptor_cleaned_assembly:
    type: "file"
    description: "Cleaned assembly in fasta format, alongside the taxonomy ID it was\
      \ screened\nagainst. Falls back to the unmodified input assembly when FCS-adaptor\
      \ found\nnothing to clean.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), val(taxid), path(fasta)\
      \ ]\n"
    pattern: "*.cleaned_sequences.fa.gz"
- fcsadaptor_report:
    type: "file"
    description: "Report of identified adaptors.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(report)\
      \ ]\n"
    pattern: "*.fcs_adaptor_report.txt"
- fcsadaptor_log:
    type: "file"
    description: "FCS-adaptor log file.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(log) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.fcs_adaptor.log"
- fcsadaptor_pipeline_args:
    type: "file"
    description: "Run arguments.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(pipeline_args) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.pipeline_args.yaml"
- fcsadaptor_skipped_trims:
    type: "file"
    description: "Skipped trim information.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(skipped_trims)\
      \ ]\n"
    pattern: "*.skipped_trims.jsonl"
- fcsgx_report:
    type: "file"
    description: "Report containing the contig identifier and recommended action (EXCLUDE,\
      \ TRIM, FIX, REVIEW).\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(report) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.fcs_gx_report.txt"
- fcsgx_taxonomy_report:
    type: "file"
    description: "Report containing the contig identifier and mapped contaminant species.\n\
      \nStructure: [ val(meta), path(taxonomy_report) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.taxonomy.rpt"
- fcsgx_log:
    type: "file"
    description: "FCS-GX log file.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(summary) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.summary.txt"
- fcsgx_hits:
    type: "file"
    description: "Intermediate FCS-GX alignments.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(hits)\
      \ ]\n"
    pattern: "*.hits.tsv.gz"
authors:
- "@scorreard"
maintainers:
- "@scorreard"
version: "0.0.0-6d1763b"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/fcs/fcsadaptor@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/fcsgx/rungx@0.0.0-6d1763b"
